typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		BRANCH as string,
		{Conf Type} as string,
		STATUS as string,
		IO as string,
		OPER as string,
		TYPE as string,
		VDATE as timestamp,
		DEALNO as string,
		{Bought CCY} as string,
		{Amount Bought} as string,
		RATE as string,
		{Sold CCY} as string,
		{Amount Sold} as string,
		SENDERREF as string,
		COMMONREF as string,
		SENDERBIC as string,
		CUSTBIC as string,
		DEALDATE as string,
		{Date Confirm Received} as timestamp,
		{Time Confirm Received} as string,
		Ctype as string,
		CNO as string,
		{Customer Name} as string,
		MATCHSENDERBIC as string,
		MATCHSENDERREF as string,
		MATCHREFDATE as timestamp,
		{Deal Aging} as string,
		{Confirmation Aging} as string,
		MAIQ_NOTES as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(Loaddate = toString(currentTimestamp())) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		SENDERBIC as string,
		Date_Confirm_Received as string,
		Customer_Name as string,
		CNO as string,
		RATE as string,
		Amount_Bought as string,
		MATCHSENDERBIC as string,
		MAIQ_NOTES as string,
		DEALDATE as string,
		STATUS as string,
		MATCHREFDATE as string,
		MATCHSENDERREF as string,
		Loaddate as string,
		DEALNO as string,
		Time_Confirm_Received as string,
		Ctype as string,
		TYPE as string,
		SENDERREF as string,
		VDATE as string,
		BRANCH as string,
		Sold_CCY as string,
		COMMONREF as string,
		ConfType as string,
		IO as string,
		Confirmation_Aging as string,
		Bought_CCY as string,
		OPER as string,
		CUSTBIC as string,
		Amount_Sold as string,
		Deal_Aging as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		SENDERBIC,
		Date_Confirm_Received = {Date Confirm Received},
		Customer_Name = {Customer Name},
		CNO,
		RATE,
		Amount_Bought = {Amount Bought},
		MATCHSENDERBIC,
		MAIQ_NOTES,
		DEALDATE,
		STATUS,
		MATCHREFDATE,
		MATCHSENDERREF,
		Loaddate,
		DEALNO,
		Time_Confirm_Received = {Time Confirm Received},
		Ctype,
		TYPE,
		SENDERREF,
		VDATE,
		BRANCH,
		Sold_CCY = {Sold CCY},
		COMMONREF,
		ConfType = {Conf Type},
		IO,
		Confirmation_Aging = {Confirmation Aging},
		Bought_CCY = {Bought CCY},
		OPER,
		CUSTBIC,
		Amount_Sold = {Amount Sold},
		Deal_Aging = {Deal Aging}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
